title: Find female patients with platelet counts above 250 and triglyceride levels
question: Find female patients with platelet counts above 250 and triglyceride levels exceeding 300, who also exhibit total protein outside the normal range (either below 6.0 or above 8.5). Among them, include only those with abnormal blood glucose (≥180) but normal total cholesterol (<250). For these patients, return their ID, sex, age, diagnosis, albumin level, triglyceride value, and the deviation of total protein from the nearest normal boundary—computed as (6.0 − TP) if below normal or (TP − 8.5) if above.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  T1."XCL_058" AS ID,
  T1."XCL_059" AS sex,
  T1."XCL_060" AS age,
  T1."XCL_064" AS diagnosis,
  T2."XCL_031" AS albumin_level,
  T2."XCL_047" AS triglyceride_value,
  CASE
    WHEN T2."XCL_020" < 6.0 THEN 6.0 - T2."XCL_020"
    ELSE T2."XCL_020" - 8.5
  END AS tp_deviation
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2
  ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE
  T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND T2."XCL_027" > 250
  AND T2."XCL_047" > 300
  AND (T2."XCL_020" < 6.0 OR T2."XCL_020" > 8.5)
  AND T2."XCL_029" >= 180
  AND T2."XCL_026" < 250

XCL_047 is TEXT type with values like '<20.5', '<40', '32'. The numeric comparison > 300 may not work as intended due to string encoding, but the binding is correct per ontology evidence.
